stdout:
strictRomSamplingError : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ
@constructionDistinguisher_rom_and_rejection_bound : ∀ {m queryCount : ℕ},
  romConstructionTarget →
    ∀ (statement : Statement m) (receipt : Receipt m queryCount)
      (verdict : List (SpAnswer BaseFoldBcsFiatShamir.Rate BaseFoldBcsFiatShamir.Cap) → Bool),
      |realProb (constructionDistinguisher statement receipt verdict) (0, 0) -
              idealProb (constructionDistinguisher statement receipt verdict) (0, 0)| +
          uniformProb (Fin queryCount → Digest) QuerySeedRejection ≤
        strictRomSamplingError (transcriptPrimitiveWork statement receipt) queryCount
@add_rawFailure_le_strictLedger : ∀ {m queryCount : ℕ} {tau rawFailure equivocation : ℝ},
  rawFailure ≤ ↑m * (3 / ↑(Fintype.card E)) + (1 - tau) ^ queryCount + equivocation →
    ∀ {receiptWork : ℕ} {romAdvantage rejection : ℝ},
      romAdvantage + rejection ≤ strictRomSamplingError receiptWork queryCount →
        rawFailure + romAdvantage + rejection ≤
          ↑m * (3 / ↑(Fintype.card E)) + (1 - tau) ^ queryCount + equivocation +
            strictRomSamplingError receiptWork queryCount
@strictAcceptedRawRomLedger : ∀ {ell m queryCount : ℕ},
  romConstructionTarget →
    ∀ (T : FoldingTower E (PowerTwoFriLevels ell) m)
      (st : RawFriAdaptiveTranscript fun n => BinaryMerkle.openingScheme hashSuite (ell - n)) (hell : ell ≤ 28)
      (hmell : m ≤ ell) (z : Fin m → E) (H : E) (word : PowerTwoFriLevels ell 0 → E) (prover : (ℕ → E) → ℕ → E[X])
      {tau : ℝ},
      tau ≤ 1 →
        (∀ (j : Fin m), tau ≤ 1 / ↑(Fintype.card (PowerTwoFriLevels ell (↑j + 1)))) →
          (st.word 0 fun i => i.elim0) = word →
            ¬BaseFoldExactClaim T z H word →
              PrefixMeasurable prover →
                (∀ (chi : ℕ → E), ∀ i < m, (prover chi i).degree < ↑(2 + 1)) →
                  ∀ (statement : Statement m) (receipt : Receipt m queryCount)
                    (verdict : List (SpAnswer BaseFoldBcsFiatShamir.Rate BaseFoldBcsFiatShamir.Cap) → Bool),
                    (uniformProb ((Fin m → E) × AcceptedSeedFamily queryCount) fun sample =>
                            BaseFoldRawCommittedIorAccepts (fun n => BinaryMerkle.openingScheme hashSuite (ell - n)) T
                              st z H prover queryCount sample.1
                              (powerTwoCoherentSchedule hmell (acceptedSeedCoordinates hell sample.2))) +
                          |realProb (constructionDistinguisher statement receipt verdict) (0, 0) -
                              idealProb (constructionDistinguisher statement receipt verdict) (0, 0)| +
                        uniformProb (Fin queryCount → Digest) QuerySeedRejection ≤
                      (↑m * (3 / ↑(Fintype.card E)) + (1 - tau) ^ queryCount +
                          uniformProb ((Fin m → E) × QueryCoordinateFamily ell queryCount) fun sample =>
                            FriRawAdaptiveEquivocates (fun n => BinaryMerkle.openingScheme hashSuite (ell - n)) T st
                              sample.1 queryCount (powerTwoCoherentSchedule hmell sample.2)) +
                        strictRomSamplingError (transcriptPrimitiveWork statement receipt) queryCount
